name: focus-cycles
description: Focus Cycles — built on Sebastian Marshall's Work Cycles framework.
author: Bud Hennekes

scripts.verify:native: node scripts/verify-navigation.cjs && node scripts/verify-no-weather.cjs && node scripts/verify-window-controls.cjs && node scripts/verify-onboarding.cjs && node scripts/verify-quotes.cjs && node scripts/verify-polish.cjs && node scripts/verify-history-timezone.cjs && node scripts/verify-media-lifecycle.cjs && electron docs/qa/native-reliability-verification.cjs
scripts.test: npm run smoke && node scripts/controlled-clock-probe.cjs && node scripts/onboarding-regression.cjs && node --test scripts/window-controls.test.cjs scripts/package-contracts.test.cjs scripts/local-help.test.cjs
scripts.audit:release: npm audit && npm test && node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check scripts/package-direct.js && node --check scripts/package-mas.js && node --check scripts/stamp-icon.js && node --check scripts/verify-package.js
scripts.release-zip: rm -rf /tmp/fc-sign && mkdir -p /tmp/fc-sign && ditto --norsrc --noextattr --noacl "dist/Focus Cycles-darwin-arm64/Focus Cycles.app" "/tmp/fc-sign/Focus Cycles.app" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "/tmp/fc-sign/Focus Cycles.app" && codesign --verify --deep --strict "/tmp/fc-sign/Focus Cycles.app" && cd /tmp/fc-sign && ditto -c -k --keepParent "Focus Cycles.app" /tmp/FocusCycles-mac-arm64.zip && echo 'Signed zip at /tmp/FocusCycles-mac-arm64.zip'
